correctness.rationale: Uniform length-n 11-avoiding words number F_{n+2}. A fixed legal prefix u of length k has exact count F_{n-k+2} if u ends 0 and F_{n-k+1} if ends 1; limiting cylinder mass c(u)=phi^-k or phi^-(k+1). Perron decomposition of primitive Fibonacci transfer matrix gives exponentially asymptotically independent fixed prefixes and suffixes. Every fixed legal centered block appears >=t times with probability 1-O(exp(-c n)) by uniform positive probability of prescribing 0 v 0 at spaced positions. Effective bounded-degree Hanf locality for directed successor paths with unary P makes any fixed FO sentence, with exponentially small exception, a Boolean function of bounded prefixes/suffixes; hence its limit is a finite sum of products c(u)c(v) in Z[phi], convergence exponential. Conversely for alpha=m+d phi in (0,1), Fibonacci integer coefficient expansion of alpha phi^(k+1)=a_k phi+b_k with b_k=a_{k-1} satisfies 0<=a_k<=F_{k+1}, 0<=b_k<=F_k for large k. Choosing exactly those counts of length-k admissible prefixes ending respectively 0 and 1 gives a FO-definable cylinder event with limit alpha. Trivial endpoints 0,1; irrationality gives only rational 0 and 1; dense Z[phi]∩[0,1]. Independently checked finite cylinder counts, endpoint pair transfer counts, and exact conjugate integer realizations.
